standardization: Absolute query-neighbor difference divided by the query's training-fold feature standard deviation. Columns with equal training minimum and maximum are excluded from standardized distributions; their raw differences and nonzero mismatch counts are retained.
gain_sign_relation_definition: Agree/disagree compare two nonzero raw label gain signs; either gain within1e-12 of zero is tie_involved.

feature_semantics.current_green_elapsed_norm: min(executor.green_elapsed_sec / max(min_green_sec,1),4); the stored feature is capped and cannot resolve durations above the cap.
feature_semantics.queue_max: Maximum incoming-lane queue proxy: halted vehicles +0.35*vehicle count +0.025*TraCI occupancy in percent, among candidate green/red lanes.
feature_semantics.queue_cv: Population standard deviation / max(abs(mean),1) for candidate green/red incoming-lane queues, as defined by the existing extractor; this is a stabilized dispersion measure.
feature_semantics.protocol_description_correction: The frozen protocol called queue_max a halted count. The frozen extractor confirms it is the weighted queue proxy; all analyzed columns and values are unchanged.

limitations: These144 pairs share48 queries and reuse training groups; they are dependent descriptive comparisons.
Differences in omitted features do not establish a cause of gain-sign changes or justify a tuned gate.
The stored phase-age feature is capped at4; equal stored values do not establish equal physical phase ages.
This audit concerns the original training OOF bank, not C deployment-state coverage.
interpretation: The144 fixed pairs contain59 same-sign,69 opposite-sign and16 tie-involved label comparisons.

Among45 pairs from15 harmful queries,33 have opposite nonzero gain signs and10 have the same sign. All13 omitted-column standardized-gap medians are smaller in the opposite-sign group than in the same-sign group.
The overall and per-seed feature-gap directions vary; seed2027 also lacks consistent separation. Omitted-feature differences do not directly explain the observed sign changes.
This descriptive result does not test whether the fixed omitted-feature block can improve a fitted predictor. A single complete-block ablation is the next direct test.
